reason: My cousin in India already handles this kind of thing for me and I trust him with the flat money more than a company I've just seen an ad for. The fee is fine, but I would not hand a lump sum to a new outfit without someone I know vouching for it.
objection: I'm not sure about the tax side in India and Canada, and I don't know this company. A free CA call helps, but it is their CA, and if the tax is wrong on a flat sale I'm the one who pays.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or relative who has actually moved a flat-sale amount through them, or my own CA in India or Canada confirming the paperwork and tax position independently.
